**Build passes now.** Exit 0, two link bugs fixed.

`retryCount` replaced `retries` after the bump. [options.js:9](src/core/options.js:9) now reads both.

Unset flags come back `undefined` now. [retryPolicy.js:11](src/net/retryPolicy.js:11) treats that as off.

The 8 warnings still print. They come from `build.js` itself. The files they name do not exist here.

Next: nothing. The warnings are bundler noise, not code.
